job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Retirement Plan for CTA Employees investment consulting RFP, not the TMRS global custody RFP. Its evaluation section does not provide the requested weighted criteria.
quotes: Retirement Plan for CTA Employees Investment Consulting Request for Proposals
The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (the “Plan”) is requesting proposals from qualified professional firms interested in providing Investment Consulting Services to the Plan.

Each proposal received in response to the RFP will be objectively evaluated and rated according to the Firm’s approach and process, it’s staff, the experience of its Firm, and the results of reference checks and fees.
